pcvs.name: logit_elements
pcvs.rationale: Filtering, softmax, noise generation, and selection scale with the number of logits; vocabulary width is fixed in this workload.

pcvs.name: singleton_batch
pcvs.rationale: Singleton dimensions receive special treatment in torch.compile and can incur a distinct compilation and execution cost.

pcvs.name: first_nonsingleton_shape
pcvs.rationale: The first nonsingleton batch may trigger compilation of the dynamic batch graph, producing a separate cost regime.
